tool_record.revisedPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: transparent full-car showcase portrait for a racing game's LEFT preview frame, not a racing sprite. Input image 1 is the ORIGINAL concept/source design of Pulse GT and is mandatory identity reference; the front/nose in this top-down source is at the BOTTOM (magenta headlamps), the top is the rear. Preserve this exact electric-blue widebody GT, cyan edge lighting, magenta headlamp shape, hood vents, dark glass canopy, wheel/fender profiles and body proportions. Convert to a car-show exhibition view, not a new car design. Geographic frame: car heading straight north; camera situated north-northwest, 30 degrees WEST of its forward/north axis, looking at it from LEFT FRONT, camera level at the middle height of the car body. Zero bird's-eye elevation, zero camera roll; show recognizable FRONT plus LEFT SIDE, wheel circles viewed side-on, not a top-down view or rear view. Infer only previously occluded side panels consistently. Keep the original polished, crisp stylized 3D rendering and materials; no change of colors, branding or car class. Single car, complete four-wheel vehicle fully within a square canvas, centered, 10% clear margin, consistent catalog scale. Real transparent alpha background, no green backdrop, no floor/platform/scenery, no text, no watermarks, no diagrams or other cars.
